Help to build the community around the students around the hall.

positions.title: Undergraduate Intern
positions.description:
Worked diligently with an MIS team as an IT Services Management Undergraduate Intern.

Achievements:
•	Efficiently worked with PuTTY's Secure Shell, Oracle SQL Developer, and Softerra LDAP Browser in order to troubleshoot the application IBM Connections 4.0
•	Swiftly developed a Java application to automatize the handling of a particular IBM Connections 4.0 type of incidents
•	Accurately and consistently handled each PNC employee's technical incidents and problems which provided a good customer service and fomented productivity in other PNC lines of business
•	Accurately completed documentation to support over thirty PNC applications

positions.title: Shipper/Picker
positions.description:
Worked in one of the many warehouses owned by interDesign, Inc. as a full-time shipper for a year after I graduated high school and before I went to college.  I returned as a seasonal worker for the next three years during winter and summer breaks.

Achievements:
•	Accurately and consistently picked the products according to the customers’ orders in a daily basis, which provided a good customer service
•	Correctly and efficiently organized the customers’ orders in a wooden pallet with a timely fashion in order to be shipped out to the customers, which promoted the company’s reliability to deliver their many daily orders
•	Effectively worked among coworkers to pull large orders when necessary, which greatly increased the teams’ productivity
•	Carried the respect of coworkers through encouraging positive community which further promoted a great work environment among all the InterDesign staff
